utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can handle one pickup spot—what time should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo—could you be there at 7:15? I really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, 7:15 works for me. I’ll be there on time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to check the timing and make sure the route works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That sounds reasonable — can you confirm the timing and route once you check?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I’ll check both and get back to you once I know the timing and the best route.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the carpool. I think I can do Tuesday, but I’d need a reminder for the time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, absolutely — I’ll remind you. I think it’s after school, but let me double-check the exact time and I’ll get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, that’d help. Just let me know the exact time when you check.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll repeat the carpool plan to everyone and make sure Ira has the details too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. Just send me the carpool details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll send the carpool details to you and repeat the plan to everyone else too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I’m late—did you already sort out the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries — I haven’t sorted it yet, but I can help if you want. We can figure out who’s driving and the pickup times together.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, thanks — let’s do that. I can drive if you want, and we just need to pin down the pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Quinn — let’s keep it simple: I can do the 8:00 pickup, and you take the afternoon run. If that works, we’re set for the week.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Eli — I’ve got the afternoon run. Thanks, and if anyone else wants in on the carpool, I’ll pass it along!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, Quinn. That keeps the routine tidy — if anyone joins, just let me know and we’ll fold them in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Sam, are we still on for the carpool tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep, we’re still on for tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what time should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I can help coordinate the carpool—who all needs a ride, and what time are we aiming for?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got Mia and Ben needing a ride, and I think we should aim for 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll line up Mia and Ben for 7:30 and make sure we’ve got enough seats. Want me to check who’s driving or are you covering that?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What time and days do you need me for?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — we need help on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays, with pickup at 3:15 and drop-off by 3:45. Does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, that works for me — I can do Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays for the 3:15 pickup and 3:45 drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the carpool supplies if you want—just let me know what we need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: That’d be great—thanks. I’ll send you the list once I’ve checked what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect—just send it over, and I’ll make sure we’re stocked up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the carpool’s still on, but the pickup times might shift a bit—I'll know more soon. Want me to keep an ear out and tell you if anything changes?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, please. I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it—I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as I hear anything about the pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure — what details do you want me to check about the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Could you check whether the pickup time is still 3:15, and who’s driving on Friday?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check both: whether pickup is still 3:15 and who’s driving on Friday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help with carpool—just tell me the pickup time and where to meet.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great — pickup is at 7:30 by the corner store. I’ll text you the exact spot if it changes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — 7:30 by the corner store works for me. Text me if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check the carpool time and let you know, then I’ll pass the plan along if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — that’d be super helpful. Just let me know once you’ve checked, and I’ll keep everyone posted if needed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check it today and circle back soon, then I’ll pass the updated plan along if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the carpool. I think we’re still on for it, but I may have missed a change.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m not sure either, Noah. If there was a change, I missed it too—maybe we should check with the group chat.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, good idea — I’ll check the group chat now and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the carpool. What time are we aiming for?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, thanks, Rey — let’s aim for 7:30 so we’ve got a little buffer.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: 7:30 works for me. I’ll be ready a little early.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I can help keep the carpool organized. What days and pickup times are we planning for?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa — I’m thinking Monday through Friday, with pickup at 7:30 AM. I can also track the stops if you want to keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, that works for me — Monday through Friday at 7:30 AM it is. If you can track the stops, I’ll keep the schedule tidy and share it with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to sort out the pickup times and who’s driving first so nobody gets left waiting.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — let’s nail down the pickup times and drivers first, then I’ll send the invite to everyone once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds good to me. If you can send the draft times first, I’ll check them and make sure the route makes sense before it goes out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are we definitely set for the carpool, Hana?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not fully sure yet — I want to check the details first. Let me confirm the time and pickup spot, then I’ll tell you for sure.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — please confirm the time and pickup spot, and then let me know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Dane—let’s keep it simple. What time are we leaving, and who’s riding with who?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Let’s leave at 7:30, and I can ride with you if that works.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me. I’ll be ready at 7:30, and we can ride together.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I haven’t heard the latest on the carpool yet—what’s the update?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I haven’t heard a firm update yet, but I’m checking with the folks organizing it. I’ll let you know as soon as I know whether the schedule changed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Cleo — I appreciate you checking. Just let me know when you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the carpool. I’m pretty sure I can take my turn, but let me double-check the time and I’ll get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good, Oren — just let me know when you’ve checked the time, and I’ll keep it on my side too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Mara — I’ll check my schedule right now and message you soon. Sorry for the wobble!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can do the school run this week if that helps—what days are you covering the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That helps a lot — I’ve got Monday and Wednesday covered, and I can take Friday too if needed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — I can take Tuesday and Thursday, and if Friday gets tricky I’ll let you know. Thanks for splitting it with me.
